title: Functorial total-limit realization of coefficient-system reindexing laws
statement: For a scheme isomorphism g:X→Y, applying the functorial coefficient-system total limit to the system identities of PodSystemReindexingLaws l E g yields the evaluation, transpose, ambient beta and counit identities collected in PodSystemReindexedRealization l E g.

proof.text: Each component of PodSystemReindexedRealization is obtained by applying the functorial coefficient-system limit to the corresponding equality of actual system arrows in PodSystemReindexingLaws. Functoriality preserves composition and identities, while the defining projection comparisons identify the resulting maps with the displayed realized evaluation, transpose, beta and counit maps.
